definitions.gloss: to be resurrected; to come back to life
definitions.explanation: To return from death or apparent death; to be revived.

definitions.gloss: to be revived; to be restored
definitions.explanation: For something dormant, forgotten, or declining to regain vitality or prominence.

⟦{心肺|しんぱい}→心肺：noentry⟧⟦{蘇生|そせい}→蘇生：14029_sosei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蘇|よみがえ}った。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). No transitive pair.

WRITING: Also written as ⟦{甦|よみがえ}る→甦る：17231_yomigaeru⟧ or in hiragana.

ETYMOLOGY: From {黄泉|よみ} (the underworld in Japanese mythology) + ⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ (to return).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蘇|よみがえ}る (memories come back)
- ⟦{活気|かっき}→活気：02554_kakki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蘇|よみがえ}る (vitality is restored)
- ⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蘇|よみがえ}る (memories revive)

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{復活|ふっかつ}→復活：12565_fukkatsu⟧ (revival, resurrection)
